# TERHADAP PEREMPUAN DAN ANAK

# DARI KEKERASAN.  

# BAB I

## KETENTUAN UMUM

#### Pasal 1

Dalam Peraturan Daerah ini yang dimaksud dengan:  1. Perempuan adalah seseorang yang berjenis kelamin  perempuan.  

2. Anak adalah seseorang yang belum berusia 18  (delapan belas) tahun, termasuk anak yang masih  dalam kandungan.  
3. Keluarga adalah unit terkecil dalam masyarakat  yang terdiri dari suami istri, atau suami istri dan  anaknya, atau ayah dan anaknya, atau ibu dan  anaknya, atau keluarga sedarah dalam garis lurus  ke atas atau ke bawah sampai dengan derajat  ketiga.  
4. Kekerasan adalah setiap perbuatan yang berakibat  atau dapat mengakibatkan kesengsaraan atau  penderitaan baik fisik, seksual, ekonomi, sosial,  dan psikis terhadap korban.  
5. Kekerasan terhadap Perempuan adalah setiap  tindakan yang berakibat atau mungkin berakibat  kesengsaraan atau penderitaan perempuan secara  fisik, seksual, ekonomi, sosial, psikis, termasuk  ancaman tindakan tertentu, pemaksaan atau  perampasan kemerdekaan, baik yang terjadi di  depan umum atau kehidupan pribadi.  
6. Kekerasan terhadap Anak adalah setiap tindakan  yang berakibat atau mungkin berakibat penderitaan  anak secara fisik, psikis, seksual, dan/atau  penelantaran, eksploitasi, termasuk ancaman  untuk melakukan perbuatan, pemaksaan, atau  perampasan kemerdekaan secara melawan hukum,  dan kekerasan lainnya.  
7. Korban adalah perempuan dan anak yang  mengalami kesengsaraan dan atau penderitaan  baik langsung maupun tidak langsung sebagai  akibat dari kekerasan.  
8. Anak Korban Kekerasan adalah anak yang  mengalami kekerasan dan anak yang berhadapan  dengan hukum.  
9. Pelindungan adalah segala upaya yang ditujukan  untuk memberikan rasa aman kepada korban yang  dilakukan oleh pihak keluarga, advokat, lembaga  sosial, kepolisian, kejaksaan, pengadilan, atau  pihak lainnya baik sementara maupun berdasarkan  penetapan pengadilan.  
10. Pelindungan Anak adalah segala kegiatan untuk  menjamin dan melindungi anak dan hak-haknya  agar dapat hidup, tumbuh, berkembang, dan  berpartisipasi, secara optimal sesuai dengan harkat  dan martabat kemanusiaan, serta mendapat  pelindungan dari kekerasan dan diskriminasi.  
11. Pelindungan Khusus adalah pelindungan yang  diberikan kepada anak dalam situasi darurat, anak  yang berhadapan dengan hukum, anak dari  kelompok minoritas dan terisolasi, anak yang  dieksploitasi secara ekonomi dan/atau seksual,  anak yang diperdagangkan, anak yang menjadi  korban penyalahgunaan narkotika, alkohol,  psikotropika, dan zat adiktif lainnya (napza), anak  korban penculikan, penjualan, perdagangan, anak  korban kekerasan baik fisik dan/atau mental, anak  yang menyandang cacat, dan anak korban  perlakuan salah dan penelantaran.  
12. Masyarakat adalah perseorangan, kelompok, dan  organisasi sosial dan/atau organisasi  kemasyarakatan.  
13. Rehabilitasi Sosial adalah pelayanan yang  ditujukan untuk memulihkan danmengembangkan  kemampuan seseorang yang mengalami disfungsi  sosial agar dapat melaksanakan fungsi sosialnya  secara wajar.  
14. Pelayanan adalah kegiatan dan tindakan segera  yang dilakukan kepada korban ketika melihat,  mendengar dan mengetahui akan, sedang atau  telah terjadinya kekerasan terhadap perempuan  dan anak yang dilakukan oleh tenaga professional  sesuai dengan profesi masing-masing berupa  konseling, terapi dan advokasi guna penguatan dan  pemulihan korban kekerasan.  
15. Konseling terhadap Korban adalah pemberian  bantuan oleh seorang yang ahli atau orang yang  terlatih sedemikian rupa sehingga meningkatkan  pemahaman dan kemampuan psikologis dalam  memecahkan permasalahan yang dihadapi.  
16. Pendampingan adalah segala tindakan berupa  konseling, terapi psikologis, advokasi, dan atau  bimbingan rohani, guna penguatan diri korban  kekerasan untuk menyelesaikan permasalahan  yang dihadapi.  
17. Unit Pelaksana Teknis yang selanjutnya disingkat  UPT adalah unit pelaksana teknis dinas yang  dibentuk pemerintah daerah dalam memberikan  layanan bagi perempuan dan anak yang mengalami  kekerasan, diskriminasi, pelindungan khusus, dan  masalah lainnya.  
18. Unit Pelaksana Teknis Dinas Pelindungan  Perempuan dan Anak yang selanjutnya disingkat  UPTD PPA adalah unit pelaksana teknis dinas yang  dibentuk pemerintah daerah dalam memberikan  layanan bagi perempuan dan anak yang mengalami  kekerasan, diskriminasi, pelindungan khusus, dan  masalah lainnya.  
19. Forum Pelindungan Korban Kekerasan yang  selanjutnya disingkat FPKK adalah forum  koordinasi penanganan korban kekerasan  perempuan dan anak yang penyelenggaraannya  dilakukan secara berjejaring dan dibentuk di  tingkat kabupaten, Kapanewon/kecamatan, dan  Kalurahan/desa.  
20. Rumah Aman adalah tempat tinggal sementara  atau rumah singgah untuk korban, yang diberikan  untuk memberikan pelindungan selama proses  pendampingan, guna keamanan dan kenyamanan  korban dari ancaman dan bahaya pelaku.  
21. Instansi Pemerintah adalah sebutan kolektif  meliputi satuan kerja/ satuan organisasi  kementerian/departemen, Lembaga Pemerintah  Non Departemen, kesekretariatan lembaga tinggi  negara, dan instansi pemerintah lainnya, baik  pusat maupun daerah, termasuk Badan Usaha  Milik Negara, Badan Hukum Milik Negara, dan  Badan Usaha.  
22. Daerah adalah Kabupaten Gunungkidul. 8
23. Pemerintah Daerah adalah Bupati dan perangkat  daerah sebagai unsur penyelenggara pemerintahan  daerah.  
24. Bupati adalah Bupati Gunungkidul.  
25. Dinas Pemberdayaan Perempuan, Pelindungan  Anak, dan Keluarga Berencana, Pemberdayaan  Masyarakat dan Desa Kabupaten Gunungkidul  yang selanjutnya disebut Dinas, adalah unsur  pelaksana urusan pemerintahan dalam bidang  pemberdayaan perempuan dan pelindungan anak.

#### Pasal 2

Pelindungan perempuan dan anak bertujuan untuk:  a. menjamin terpenuhinya hak-hak perempuan dan  anak agar dapat berpartisipasi secara optimal dalam  masyarakat sesuai harkat dan martabat  kemanusiaan;  
b. memberikan pelindungan dan memberikan rasa  aman kepada perempuan dan anak dari segala  bentuk kekerasan dan diskriminasi;  
c. mencegah dan menghapus segala bentuk kekerasan  dan ekspolitasi terhadap perempuan dan anak  termasuk perdagangan orang;  
d. memberikan pelayanan kepada perempuan dan  anak korban kekerasan, pelapor, dan saksi;  
e. memulihkan, menguatkan fisik dan mental  perempuan dan anak korban kekerasan; danf. meningkatkan kepedulian dan partisipasi  masyarakat dalam pencegahan kekerasan terhadap  perempuan dan anak.

# BAB II

## KEWENANGAN PEMERINTAH DAERAH

#### Pasal 3

1. Bupati berwenang menyelenggarakan pelindungan  kepada perempuan dan anak dari kekerasan.  (2) Kewenangan sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1)  meliputi:a. pencegahan kekerasan;  
b. layanan terhadap korban kekerasan; dan  c. penguatan dan pengembangan kelembagaan.

#### Pasal 4

1. Dalam melaksanakan kewenangan sebagaimana  dimaksud dalam Pasal 3, Bupati menetapkan  program dan kegiatan pelindungan perempuan dan  anak dalam Rencana Aksi Daerah.  
2. Rencana Aksi Daerah sebagaimana dimaksud pada  ayat (1) paling sedikit memuat:a. program dan kegiatan aksi pelindungan  perempuan dan anak dari kekerasan;  
b. program dan kegiatan aksi daerah untuk  mencegah segala bentuk kekerasan dan  diskriminasi terhadap perempuan dan anak;  
c. program dan kegiatan aksi perbaikan dan  peningkatan pelayanan pelindungan perempuan  dan anak dari kekerasan; dand. program dan kegiatan aksi pemberdayaan  perempuan dari kekerasan.  
3. Ketentuan mengenai Rencana Aksi Daerah  sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) diatur lebih  lanjut dengan Peraturan Bupati.

# BAB III

## PENCEGAHAN KEKERASAN

## Bagian Kesatu

Jenis Kekerasan

#### Pasal 5

Jenis kekerasan antara lain:
a. kekerasan fisik;  
b. kekerasan psikis;  
c. kekerasan seksual;  
d. penelantaran;  
e. eksploitasi; dan/atauf. kekerasan lainnya.

# AGAINST WOMEN AND CHILDREN

# FROM VIOLENCE.

# CHAPTER I

## GENERAL PROVISIONS

#### Article 1

In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by:
1. Woman is a person who is female in gender.

2. Child is a person who has not yet reached the age of 18 (eighteen) years, including a child still in the womb.
3. Family is the smallest unit in society consisting of husband and wife, or husband and wife and their children, or father and his children, or mother and her children, or blood relatives in direct lineage upward or downward up to the third degree.
4. Violence is any act that results in or may result in misery or suffering whether physical, sexual, economic, social, and psychological to the victim.
5. Violence against Women is any act that results in or may result in misery or suffering of women physically, sexually, economically, socially, psychologically, including threats of certain acts, coercion or deprivation of liberty, whether occurring in public or private life.
6. Violence against Children is any act that results in or may result in suffering of children physically, psychologically, sexually, and/or neglect, exploitation, including threats to commit acts, coercion, or unlawful deprivation of liberty, and other violence.
7. Victim is a woman and child who experiences misery and or suffering either directly or indirectly as a result of violence.
8. Child Victim of Violence is a child who experiences violence and a child in conflict with the law.
9. Protection is all efforts aimed at providing a sense of security to victims carried out by family, advocates, social institutions, police, prosecutors, courts, or other parties either temporarily or based on court determination.
10. Child Protection is all activities to guarantee and protect children and their rights so that they can live, grow, develop, and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity and dignity, and receive protection from violence and discrimination.
11. Special Protection is protection given to children in emergency situations, children in conflict with the law, children from minority and isolated groups, children who are economically and/or sexually exploited, children who are trafficked, children who are victims of narcotics, alcohol, psychotropic, and other addictive substance abuse (drugs), child victims of kidnapping, sale, trafficking, child victims of violence both physical and/or mental, children with disabilities, and child victims of maltreatment and neglect.
12. Society is individuals, groups, and social organizations and/or community organizations.
13. Social Rehabilitation is a service aimed at restoring and developing the ability of a person experiencing social dysfunction so that they can perform their social functions properly.
14. Service is immediate activities and actions taken to victims when seeing, hearing and knowing of, during or after the occurrence of violence against women and children carried out by professionals in accordance with their respective professions in the form of counseling, therapy and advocacy for strengthening and recovery of victims of violence.
15. Counseling for Victims is the provision of assistance by an expert or trained person in such a way as to increase psychological understanding and ability in solving the problems faced.
16. Assistance is all actions in the form of counseling, psychological therapy, advocacy, and or spiritual guidance, for strengthening victims of violence to resolve the problems faced.
17. Technical Implementation Unit hereinafter abbreviated as UPT is a technical implementation unit of the agency established by the regional government in providing services for women and children who experience violence, discrimination, special protection, and other problems.
18. Technical Implementation Unit of the Women and Child Protection Agency hereinafter abbreviated as UPTD PPA is a technical implementation unit of the agency established by the regional government in providing services for women and children who experience violence, discrimination, special protection, and other problems.
19. Forum for Protection of Victims of Violence hereinafter abbreviated as FPKK is a coordination forum for handling victims of violence against women and children whose implementation is carried out in a networked manner and established at the regency, Kapanewon/sub-district, and Kalurahan/village levels.
20. Safe House is a temporary residence or shelter for victims, provided to provide protection during the assistance process, for the safety and comfort of victims from threats and dangers of perpetrators.
21. Government Agency is a collective term covering work units/organizational units of ministries/departments, Non-Departmental Government Institutions, secretariats of state high institutions, and other government agencies, both central and regional, including State-Owned Enterprises, State-Owned Legal Entities, and Business Entities.
22. Region is Gunungkidul Regency.
23. Regional Government is the Regent and regional apparatus as elements of regional government administration.
24. Regent is the Regent of Gunungkidul.
25. Office of Women's Empowerment, Child Protection, and Family Planning, Community and Village Empowerment of Gunungkidul Regency hereinafter referred to as the Office, is an implementing element of government affairs in the field of women's empowerment and child protection.

#### Article 2

Protection of women and children aims to:
a. ensure the fulfillment of the rights of women and children so that they can participate optimally in society in accordance with human dignity and dignity;
b. provide protection and provide a sense of security to women and children from all forms of violence and discrimination;
c. prevent and eliminate all forms of violence and exploitation against women and children including trafficking in persons;
d. provide services to women and children victims of violence, reporters, and witnesses;
e. restore, strengthen the physical and mental condition of women and children victims of violence; and
f. increase awareness and community participation in preventing violence against women and children.

# CHAPTER II

## AUTHORITY OF REGIONAL GOVERNMENT

#### Article 3

(1) The Regent has the authority to provide protection to women and children from violence.
(2) The authority as referred to in paragraph (1) includes:
a. prevention of violence;
b. services for victims of violence; and
c. strengthening and development of institutions.

#### Article 4

1. In exercising the authority as referred to in Article 3, the Regent establishes programs and activities for the protection of women and children in the Regional Action Plan.
2. The Regional Action Plan as referred to in paragraph (1) shall at least contain:
a. programs and activities for the protection of women and children from violence;
b. programs and activities for regional action to prevent all forms of violence and discrimination against women and children;
c. programs and activities for action to improve and enhance protection services for women and children from violence; and
d. programs and activities for action to empower women from violence.
3. Provisions regarding the Regional Action Plan as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be further regulated by Regent Regulation.

# CHAPTER III

## PREVENTION OF VIOLENCE

## Part One

Types of Violence

#### Article 5

Types of violence include:
a. physical violence;
b. psychological violence;
c. sexual violence;
d. neglect;
e. exploitation; and/or
f. other violence.

#### Article 36

1. Government Agencies as referred to in Article 35 letter a shall at minimum include Government Agencies which among others have duties and functions in the fields of:
   a. social affairs;  
   b. handling of women and children;  
   c. health;  
   d. education;  
   e. youth and sports;  
   f. religion;  
   g. population;  
   h. manpower; and/or  
   i. industry and trade.  
2. Community institutions as referred to in Article 35 letter b are grouped based on their field of activity, among others:
   a. health sector;  
   b. psychology sector;  
   c. legal sector;  
   d. social sector; and/or  
   e. economic sector.

#### Article 37

1. The Panewu shall establish the FPKK Kapanewon.  
2. The establishment of FPKK as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be stipulated by Decree of the Panewu.

#### Article 38

The FPKK Kapanewon as referred to in Article 32 paragraph (2) letter b shall have duties among others:  
 a. implementing and coordinating the handling of women and children victims of violence within the scope of the Kapanewon;  
 b. receiving referrals from FPKK Kalurahan; and/or  
 c. conducting documentation of case handling in accordance with the mechanisms and service standards that have been established.

#### Article 39

The FPKK Kapanewon as referred to in Article 32 paragraph (2) letter b shall at minimum consist of elements of:  
 a. health;  
 b. education;  
 c. law;  
 d. psychosocial;  
 e. community;  
 f. spirituality;  
 g. children's forum; and/or  
 h. empowerment.

#### Article 40

1. The FPKK Kalurahan shall be established by the Lurah.  
2. The establishment of FPKK Kalurahan as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be stipulated by Decree of the Lurah.  
3. In the event that the FPKK Kalurahan as referred to in paragraph (1) has not yet been established, the FPKK Kabupaten and/or FPKK Kapanewon may provide facilitation and assistance.

#### Article 41

The FPKK Kalurahan as referred to in Article 32 paragraph (2) letter c shall at minimum consist of elements of:  
 a. health;  
 b. education;  
 c. law;  
 d. community leaders;  
 e. religious leaders;  
 f. children's forum/youth organization;  
 g. Kalurahan officials; and/or  
 h. other related organizations/institutions.

#### Article 42

The FPKK Kalurahan as referred to in Article 32 paragraph (2) letter c shall have duties among others:
 a. preparing programs and activities in efforts to prevent and handle violence against women and children within the scope of the Kalurahan; and/or  
 b. referring cases and coordinating with FPKK Kapanewon or FPKK Kabupaten in the event that the FPKK Kalurahan experiences obstacles related to case handling.

# CHAPTER VI

## COMMUNITY PARTICIPATION

#### Article 43

1. The community may participate in the implementation of protection of women and children victims of acts of violence.  
2. Community participation as referred to in paragraph (1) among others:
   a. establishing family partners at the kalurahan level;  
   b. establishing community institutions whose field of work is in the protection of women and children;  
   c. conducting socialization of the rights of women and children independently;  
   d. conducting prevention efforts if finding indications of violence against women and children in the community;  
   e. providing first aid to women and children victims of violence; and  
   f. reporting to the competent authority if violence against women and children occurs in their environment.  
3. Community participation as referred to in paragraph (1) may be carried out by individuals, community institutions, educational institutions, religious institutions, and the business sector.

#### Article 44

1. The Regional Government shall involve the business sector and private parties to participate in the protection of women and children.  
2. Participation as referred to in paragraph (1) may be in the form of:
   a. socialization to employees in the business environment regarding the rights of women and children;  
   b. socialization to employees in the business environment regarding the dangers of acts of violence against women and children;  
   c. providing assistance in the implementation of protection of women and children as a form of corporate social responsibility.

# CHAPTER VII

## FUNDING

#### Article 45

In order to support the implementation of protection for women and children victims of acts of violence, funding is required which may be sourced from:
 a. Regional Revenue and Expenditure Budget (APBD);  
 b. Kalurahan Revenue and Expenditure Budget (APBKal); and  
 c. other lawful and non-binding sources in accordance with applicable laws and regulations.

# CHAPTER VIII

## GUIDANCE AND SUPERVISION

#### Article 46

1. The Regent shall conduct guidance and supervision of the implementation of protection of women and children victims of acts of violence.  
2. Guidance and supervision as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be implemented by the Agency.  
3. Guidance and supervision as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be conducted in order to realize the objectives of implementing protection of women and children victims of violence in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations.  
4. Guidance and supervision shall be implemented at least (two) times per year.

# CHAPTER IX

## CLOSING PROVISIONS

#### Article 47

1. At the time this Regional Regulation comes into force, the provisions of laws and regulations governing the Establishment, Organizational Structure, Duties, Functions, and Work Procedures by the Technical Implementers of Protection of Women and Children are declared to remain in force insofar as they are not contrary to the provisions in this Regional Regulation or are not specifically regulated in this Regional Regulation.  
2. At the time this Regional Regulation comes into force, the FPKK that has been established is declared to remain in force insofar as it is not contrary to the provisions in this Regional Regulation or is not specifically regulated in this Regional Regulation.

#### Article 48

At the time this Regional Regulation comes into force:  
 a. Regional Regulation of Gunungkidul Regency Number 25 of 2012 concerning Protection of Women and Children Victims of Violence (Regional Gazette of Gunungkidul Regency Year 2012 Number 25); and
 b. Regulation of the Regent of Gunungkidul Number 48 of 2019 concerning Implementation of Protection of Women and Children Victims of Violence (Regional News of Gunungkidul Regency Year 2019 Number 48);  

are revoked and declared invalid.

#### Article 49

This Regional Regulation shall come into force on the date of promulgation.  

In order that everyone may know of it, the promulgation of this Regional Regulation is ordered with its placement in the Regional Gazette of Gunungkidul Regency.  

Enacted in Wonosari on 17 January 2020

Senior Supervisor (Pembina Tingkat I), IV/b

##### ELUCIDATION

##### OF

##### REGIONAL REGULATION OF GUNUNGKIDUL REGENCY  NUMBER 1 OF 2020

##### CONCERNING

IMPLEMENTATION OF PROTECTION OF  WOMEN AND CHILDREN FROM VIOLENCE

##### I. GENERAL

That women and children as vulnerable groups in family and community life often experience problems that violate human rights, that protection of women and children is a mandatory concurrent affair which is the authority, obligation, and responsibility of the Regional Government, so that regulation is needed as a basis for implementing comprehensive and integrated protection of women and children in a Regional Regulation.  

In this regard, protection efforts in the Region are needed in the form of institutional support and regulations that can guarantee its implementation. This Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts specifically in terms of prevention, services and empowerment of women and children from violence in Gunungkidul Regency.

##### II. ARTICLE BY ARTICLE

#### Article 1

Sufficiently clear.
